body.zh-Hant: 奧爾蒂斯1886年9月24日生於布宜諾斯艾利斯，職業為律師，所屬政黨為激進公民聯盟（Unión Cívica Radical）。他1909年取得布宜諾斯艾利斯大學的法學學位，在首都建立起成功的律師事務所之後，才轉向謀求公職。
body.en: Ortiz was born in Buenos Aires on 24 September 1886, worked as a lawyer, and belonged to the Unión Cívica Radical. He received a law degree from the University of Buenos Aires in 1909 and, after establishing a successful law practice in the capital, sought public office.

heading.zh-Hant: 地方議會、國會與公共工程部

body.zh-Hant: 奧爾蒂斯1918至1920年間擔任布宜諾斯艾利斯市議員，之後進入阿根廷眾議院，代表布宜諾斯艾利斯至1924年。1925年阿爾韋亞總統任命他為公共工程部長；總統府的內閣名單載明任期自1925年1月13日至1928年10月12日。他是反個人主義激進派的主要人物之一。
body.en: Ortiz served as a Buenos Aires city councilman between 1918 and 1920, then moved to the Argentine Chamber of Deputies, representing Buenos Aires until 1924. In 1925 President Alvear appointed him minister of public works; the presidency's cabinet list gives the term as 13 January 1925 to 12 October 1928. He was one of the leading Anti-Personalist Radicals.

body.zh-Hant: 總統府的賈斯托政府內閣名單載明，奧爾蒂斯自1936年1月4日至1937年6月21日任財政部長。賈斯托挑選他為接班人，1938年他當選總統；總統府記載其任期自1938年2月20日至1942年6月27日。任內他試圖遏止1930年後破壞阿根廷民主的選舉舞弊，但實質改革未及推行，1940年糖尿病迫使他把權力交給卡斯蒂略，1942年6月辭職。
body.en: The presidency's cabinet list for Justo's government shows Ortiz as finance minister from 4 January 1936 to 21 June 1937. Justo chose him as successor and he was elected president in 1938; the presidency records his term as 20 February 1938 to 27 June 1942. In office he tried to curtail the electoral fraud that had undermined Argentine democracy after 1930, but substantive change did not come: in 1940 diabetes forced him to delegate power to Ramón Castillo, and in June 1942 he resigned.

body.zh-Hant: 總統府的內閣名單載明：奧爾蒂斯政府自1938年2月20日起，皮德羅·格羅波任財政部長、卡洛斯·馬爾克斯任戰爭部長、迪奧赫內斯·塔沃阿達任內政部長、何塞·馬里亞·坎蒂洛任外交與宗教部長。馬爾克斯的任期延續到1942年6月27日；格羅波、塔沃阿達與坎蒂洛則任至1940年9月2日。
body.en: The presidency's cabinet list shows that from 20 February 1938 Pedro Groppo was finance minister, Carlos Márquez war minister, Diógenes Taboada interior minister and José María Cantilo foreign minister. Márquez served until 27 June 1942, while Groppo, Taboada and Cantilo served until 2 September 1940.

body.zh-Hant: 阿斯奎斯是約克郡一名服裝製造商之子，就讀於倫敦城市學校與牛津大學貝利奧爾學院，在牛津聯合會當上主席，1876年取得出庭律師資格。1886年他當選自由黨籍東法夫選區的下議院議員；議會紀錄載明他自1886年7月1日起代表該選區（Fife Eastern）。
body.en: Asquith was the son of a Yorkshire clothing manufacturer. He was educated at the City of London School and Balliol College, Oxford, where he became President of the Union, and was called to the Bar in 1876. In 1886 he was elected Liberal MP for East Fife; the parliamentary record shows him sitting for Fife Eastern from 1 July 1886.

body.zh-Hant: 1892年他在格萊斯頓治下出任內政大臣，其後在羅斯伯里勳爵治下再度任此職；議會紀錄列其內政大臣任期為1892至1895年。1895年下野後他回到律師業，並巡迴各地發表支持自由貿易的演說。1905年新自由黨政府成立，他出任財政大臣，提高非勞動所得稅，用以支付七十歲以上老人年金。
body.en: In 1892 he became Home Secretary under Gladstone and again under Lord Rosebery; the parliamentary record lists his Home Secretaryship as 1892 to 1895. Out of office from 1895, he returned to his barrister's practice and toured the country making speeches for free trade. In 1905 he became Chancellor of the Exchequer in the new Liberal government and introduced higher taxes on unearned income to help pay for pensions for those over 70.

body.zh-Hant: 1908年坎貝爾-班納曼辭職，阿斯奎斯接任首相；議會紀錄載明他任首相自1908年4月5日起至1916年12月5日止。他對抗常阻擋改革法案的上議院；上議院否決了財政大臣勞合·喬治1909年的預算，1910年12月的大選被稱為上下兩院之爭的公投。剝奪上議院否決權的議會法案於1911年成為法律。
body.en: In 1908 Campbell-Bannerman resigned and Asquith became Prime Minister; the parliamentary record gives his premiership as 5 April 1908 to 5 December 1916. He took on the House of Lords, which often blocked reforming bills; the Lords rejected Chancellor Lloyd George's 1909 budget, and the December 1910 election was billed as a referendum on the Lords versus Commons issue. The Parliament Bill, which stripped the Lords of its veto, became law in 1911.

body.zh-Hant: 阿斯奎斯任內英國捲入第一次世界大戰；議會紀錄列其1914年曾任戰爭大臣。為爭取更多支持，他在1915年組成聯合政府，但戰事不利、政府不得人心。與勞合·喬治失和導致他於1916年12月辭職。
body.en: Britain entered the First World War under Asquith, and the parliamentary record lists him as Secretary of State for War in 1914. To maximise support he formed a coalition in 1915, but the war went badly and the government was unpopular. A rift with Lloyd George forced him to resign in December 1916.

heading.en: Loss of seat, return and peerage

body.zh-Hant: 1918年他與許多盟友一同失去議席，卻仍堅持擔任自由黨黨魁；議會紀錄載明東法夫的議席至1918年12月14日止。兩年後他在補選中贏得議席，議會紀錄載明帕斯利選區任期自1920年2月12日至1924年10月29日。1925年他受封牛津伯爵並進入上議院，1928年因中風去世，議會紀錄記載卒於1928年2月15日。
body.en: He lost his seat in 1918 along with many allies yet stubbornly remained Leader of the Liberal Party; the parliamentary record ends his East Fife seat on 14 December 1918. Two years later he won a seat in a by-election, and the record gives Paisley from 12 February 1920 to 29 October 1924. In 1925 he was granted the title of Earl of Oxford and entered the House of Lords, and he died of a stroke in 1928; the record gives 15 February 1928.
